questions.explanation: The terms 2p and 4p are like terms, so there are 2 p terms; 3q and 5 are unlike. The tempting wrong idea fails because it misapplies the rule.
questions.hint: Count terms with p. Try again carefully.

questions.stem: A draft solves x divided by 4 equals 6 and gets x equals 1.5.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.stem: A draft decreases 250 by twenty percent; report the new value.
questions.explanation: Twenty percent of 250 is 50, and 250 minus 50 is 200, so the new value is 200. The tempting wrong idea fails because it misapplies the rule.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.stem: A note reads 45 pages in 15 minutes; what is the rate per minute?

options.text: 675 pages per minute because 45 times 15 is 675.
30 pages per minute because 45 minus 15 is 30.
3 pages per minute because 45 divided by 15 is 3.
0.33 pages per minute because 15 divided by 45 is 0.33.

questions.explanation: Divide 45 by 15 to get 3 pages per minute; subtracting or multiplying does not yield a rate.
